name: timr
description_en:
timr combines working-time attendance, project time and a vehicle logbook, with mobile/offline and terminal options. Those are different records: attendance measures the workday, project time allocates it, and the logbook records journeys.

The official German price page describes a one-user Free plan restricted to one selected function. It does not provide an unlimited free team version or every module together.
description_zh:
timr 结合工作时间考勤、项目时间及行车日志，提供移动/离线及终端选项。它们是不同记录：考勤测量工作日，项目时间分配工作，行车日志记录出行。

官方德文定价页介绍单用户 Free，限选一个功能，不是团队无限免费，也不包含所有模块组合。

core_features.explanation_en: Record attendance separately from allocation to projects/tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将考勤与项目/任务时间分配分别记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Mobile apps support field records, offline use and optional GPS.
core_features.explanation_zh: 移动应用支持外勤记录、离线及可选 GPS。

en: Configure working-time types, project tasks, employees and permissions. Record the workday and allocate representative portions to two projects; compare totals without assuming project time and attendance must automatically match. Review an offline mobile entry after synchronization. No shift, journey or device was tested.
zh: 配置工作时间类型、项目任务、员工及权限，记录工作日并把代表性部分分配到两个项目，比较总额，不能默认项目时间与考勤自动一致。应在同步后审查移动离线记录。本次未测试班次、行程或设备。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a workday split between customer projects
sections.title_zh: 示例：工作日分配到多个客户项目
sections.en:
Configure working-time types, project tasks, employees and permissions. Record the workday and allocate representative portions to two projects; compare totals without assuming project time and attendance must automatically match. Review an offline mobile entry after synchronization. No shift, journey or device was tested.

A field organization should define whether GPS is needed and who may edit records, rather than infer continuous location tracking from an optional stamp.
sections.zh:
配置工作时间类型、项目任务、员工及权限，记录工作日并把代表性部分分配到两个项目，比较总额，不能默认项目时间与考勤自动一致。应在同步后审查移动离线记录。本次未测试班次、行程或设备。

外勤组织应定义是否需要 GPS 及谁可编辑，不能从可选定位推定持续轨迹。

sections.title_en: A prepaid term with no automatic renewal
sections.en:
The German FAQ states a standard €8 per user, with an additional monthly account flat fee possible by plan. Administrators require a full licence even if they log no time. Users choose a prepaid term; the page explicitly says timr does not automatically renew. Obtain the selected module/account fee, tax and annual discount before calculating a team total.

Free is one user/one function: attendance with two types, project time with five active tasks, or a restricted vehicle logbook. A fourteen-day full trial expires unless a Free or paid plan is selected. Trial breadth is not the permanent entitlement.
sections.zh:
德文 FAQ 表示标准每用户 €8，按套餐可能另加每月账户固定费。管理员即使不记工时也需完整许可。用户选择预付期限，页面明确 timr 不自动续期。计算团队总额前应确认模块/账户费、税费及年付折扣。

Free 为一用户/一功能：含两种类型的考勤、五个活跃任务的项目时间，或受限行车日志。十四天完整试用后需选择 Free 或付费，否则到期，试用范围不等于长期权益。

sections.title_en: Reconcile before billing or wage use
sections.en:
Service/field teams combining attendance and project allocation can evaluate timr. If a record is missing, check device synchronization, task selection and reporting period before duplicating it. Correct attendance and project allocation through an agreed review path.

No pay-rule compliance, GPS accuracy, API, export completeness, software licence, self-hosting or restore was verified. The bilingual profile is English synthesis/Chinese translation of German official evidence, not a claim about software interface languages.
sections.zh:
结合考勤及项目分配的服务/外勤团队可评估 timr。记录缺失时，复制前先检查设备同步、任务选择和报告周期，通过约定审查路径更正考勤与项目分配。

未核实工资规则合规、GPS 准确性、API、导出完整性、软件许可、自托管或恢复。本文是依据德文官方证据的英文整理及中文翻译，不声称软件界面语言。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Exact selected module/account fee, tax, project/attendance reconciliation, device/GPS, licence and recovery remain untested.
research_gaps.zh: 具体模块/账户费、税费、项目/考勤核对、设备/GPS、许可及恢复未测试。
